# 1. SER / BUL: consolidate core Balkan Peninsula neighbors
oe_ai2_ser_bul_balkan_corridor = {
	attacker_potential = {
		oe_ai2_ready_for_expansion = yes
		OR = {
			tag = SER
			tag = BUL
		}
	}
	candidate_list = {
		every_neighbor_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
				NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
				any_owned_location = {
					OR = {
						area = area:serbia_area
						area = area:bulgaria_area
						area = area:macedonia_area
						area = area:albania_area
						area = area:bosnia_area
						area = area:thrace_area
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_list = source
		}
	}
	score = {
		add = scope:target.country_tax_base
		multiply = 8
		add = 18
	}
	sort_value = {
		add = scope:target.country_tax_base
		multiply = 75
	}
}

# 13. Qing (MCH / post-1644 CHI): prioritize existential unification of China proper against MNG and regional rivals (1644-1690)
oe_ai2_qing_ming_existential_target = {
	attacker_potential = {
		oe_ai2_ready_for_expansion = yes
		current_year >= 1644
		current_year <= 1690
		OR = {
			tag = MCH
			AND = {
				tag = CHI
				OR = {
					has_or_had_tag = MCH
					country_exists = c:MNG
				}
			}
		}
	}
	candidate_list = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:MNG
				c:MNG = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
					NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
				}
			}
			c:MNG = { add_to_list = source }
		}
		every_neighbor_country = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
				NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
				any_owned_location = {
					OR = {
						region = region:north_china_region
						region = region:east_china_region
						region = region:south_china_region
						region = region:west_china_region
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_list = source
		}
	}
	score = {
		add = scope:target.country_tax_base
		multiply = 10
		add = 30
		if = {
			limit = { scope:target = { tag = MNG } }
			add = 80
		}
	}
	sort_value = {
		add = scope:target.country_tax_base
		multiply = 100
		if = {
			limit = { scope:target = { tag = MNG } }
			add = 120
		}
	}
}

# 14. Ming (MNG): reciprocal counter-offensive targeting Qing (MCH/CHI) and China proper reunification (1644-1690)
oe_ai2_ming_counter_qing_target = {
	attacker_potential = {
		oe_ai2_ready_for_expansion = yes
		tag = MNG
		current_year >= 1644
		current_year <= 1690
		OR = {
			country_exists = c:MCH
			country_exists = c:CHI
		}
	}
	candidate_list = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:MCH
				c:MCH = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
					NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
				}
			}
			c:MCH = { add_to_list = source }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:CHI
				c:CHI = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
					NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
				}
			}
			c:CHI = { add_to_list = source }
		}
		every_neighbor_country = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
				NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
				any_owned_location = {
					OR = {
						region = region:north_china_region
						region = region:east_china_region
						region = region:south_china_region
						region = region:west_china_region
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_list = source
		}
	}
	score = {
		add = scope:target.country_tax_base
		multiply = 10
		add = 28
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = {
					OR = {
						tag = MCH
						tag = CHI
					}
				}
			}
			add = 75
		}
	}
	sort_value = {
		add = scope:target.country_tax_base
		multiply = 95
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = {
					OR = {
						tag = MCH
						tag = CHI
					}
				}
			}
			add = 110
		}
	}
}
